method: Pairs from dossier open_owner_questions; topical screen then explicit author overrides after reading every DIRECT pair and every UNIT_SHARED pair for the narrowly scoped questions. Options and recommendations follow the master's framing.

decisions.question: Manual per-strategy budget
options: Set owner.manual risk budget in the next signed mandate (a value at or below max_risk_per_trade)
decisions.author_recommendation: Owner sets the value; master §7.4.2 already bounds it (never above max_risk_per_trade; shares 25/50/75/100%; counts toward account limits).
decisions.can_proceed_before_decision: BE-011 builds ManualStopPolicy/ManualIntentFactory with the budget read from the signed mandate; manual entry stays refused until a mandate includes owner.manual.

decisions.question: ATR stop policy per instrument class
options: Owner-signed ATR multiple per instrument class
decisions.author_recommendation: Owner sets multiples; engineering supplies measured stop-out statistics per class from backtests to inform the choice.
decisions.can_proceed_before_decision: Policy table, validation (venue stop/freeze level, never widened by quantisation) and tests with fixture multiples; no live value.

decisions.question: Manual demo acceptance period
options: Demo duration and/or trade-count criteria before LIMITED_LIVE manual trading
decisions.author_recommendation: Owner sets the criterion; master recommends demo first, then LIMITED_LIVE after owner signature.
decisions.can_proceed_before_decision: All manual-trading code and DEMO_TRADER operation; only the LIMITED_LIVE promotion waits.

decisions.question: Exact product/lock signature for formal predevelopment
options: Use an existing trusted signed mechanism to approve the scope lock (see pre003/F15_AND_IDENTITY_REQUIREMENTS.md and the OQ-05 recommendation)
decisions.author_recommendation: See the OQ-05 mechanism recommendation in pre003; no new signature format.
decisions.can_proceed_before_decision: Nothing implementation-bearing: PRE-003 cannot exit without it.

decisions.question: Licensed news/calendar provider selection
options: Select licensed news/calendar providers after current API, licence and latency evidence
decisions.author_recommendation: Owner selects after BE-014 produces current measured evidence; vendor research figures are historical, not quotes.
decisions.can_proceed_before_decision: Provider-neutral ingest adapters, source health and cross-checking against public/official sources; no purchase.

decisions.question: Automated missing-stop reattach versus immediate flatten policy
options: A: keep immediate flatten + kill switch for automated trades (current router, F-031)
B: apply the Rev1.2 re-read → re-attach (≤2 attempts, seconds) → flatten sequence to automated trades too
decisions.author_recommendation: Master states the trade-off: a few seconds' exposure versus a guaranteed spread cost and a halted account. Author recommends B for parity with manual trades, with PROTECTION_UNCONFIRMED shown as full exposure at risk; the choice is the owner's.
decisions.can_proceed_before_decision: Both paths are implemented behind the policy and tested; manual trades already use the sequence by canon.

decisions.question: Promote each news path from shadow
options: Sign promotion of each news path D4/D5 from shadow after per-path evidence
decisions.author_recommendation: Per-path owner signature by design; not a blocker.
decisions.can_proceed_before_decision: Shadow operation and evidence collection for every path.

decisions.question: No direct news risk increase; resolve signed final policy
options: Keep: news never directly increases risk (D1–D6 reduce/defer; D7 creates trades only via validated strategies)
Change: allow direct size increase
decisions.author_recommendation: Master recommends keeping the rule; author concurs (a direct increase bypasses strategy evidence).
decisions.can_proceed_before_decision: D1–D7 implementation under the keep rule, which is the safe default the canon already describes.

decisions.question: Feed bundle and authorized budget
options: Choose the feed bundle and authorize its monthly budget
decisions.author_recommendation: Owner decides after measured latency/terms evidence; the master's $230–650/month is a historical estimate.
decisions.can_proceed_before_decision: Ingest with free/official sources; paid feeds admitted later without code change.

decisions.question: Event strategies, budget, daily cap and first classes
options: Event strategies, budget, daily cap and first classes for news trading
decisions.author_recommendation: Owner signs per class after paper and shadow evidence (§8.10.9).
decisions.can_proceed_before_decision: Bundle mechanics, arming proofs, paper and shadow.

decisions.question: Behaviour notice wording and calibration
options: Engineering defines the calibration method; owner approves owner-facing wording
decisions.author_recommendation: Not a START blocker for BE-022: calibration is an engineering method; wording is presentation, after BG-001.
decisions.can_proceed_before_decision: BE-022 diagnostics payload, calibration evaluation; copy drafted in UX later.

decisions.question: Native versus qualified web chart renderer, measured after BG-001; existing spike unqualified and not evidence of completed native UI.
options: Native canvas
New native engine
Qualified web engine
decisions.author_recommendation: Resolved as an engineering decision by measurement after BG-001 against §15.1 budgets (60 fps chart gestures on S24, lifecycle soak); the renderer-independent capability contract makes any choice swappable. Not an owner question.
decisions.can_proceed_before_decision: All backend chart contracts (BE-018) and the capability contract; renderer selection happens in FE-007 after BG-001.

decisions.question: Owner-approved deletion/archive/retention grace: source record recommends 30 days while older text said 7; no implicit value chosen.
options: 7 days (older text)
30 days (source record recommendation)
Other owner-selected duration
decisions.author_recommendation: Owner selects; author notes 30 days gives more recovery time for an accidental delete while credentials are destroyed immediately either way.
decisions.can_proceed_before_decision: Grace period implemented as a signed parameter; delete blocked by open exposure regardless.

decisions.question: Portfolio reporting currency
options: USD
Another base currency
decisions.author_recommendation: Display preference only (limits stay per account). Author suggests USD, the denomination of most broker accounts, but the owner chooses.
decisions.can_proceed_before_decision: Combined view with an explicit base-currency parameter and FX source/time; no money effect.

decisions.question: Simulated replay practice actions scope
options: Practice actions in replay are simulation-only (no broker route)
Broader scope
decisions.author_recommendation: Recommend simulation-only; any broker route from replay would contradict §18.2 'never execute from a chart' spirit.
decisions.can_proceed_before_decision: Replay sandbox with simulation-only actions.

decisions.question: Premature accounts branch disposition
options: Retain as migration baseline (consolidation)
Reject
decisions.author_recommendation: Already settled: feature/rea-trading-accounts-tactile-20261015 is a selected source input (CONSOLIDATION_STATE.json source_inputs, 3b2c9e04) and existing Android code remains the migration baseline per the owner's standing instruction; its presentation is not frontend authority before BG-001.
decisions.can_proceed_before_decision: Everything; this is not an open question.

decisions.question: First admitted funding provider rail and sandbox authority
options: Select the first funding provider rail and its sandbox authority
decisions.author_recommendation: Owner selects; master rollout: one rail in sandbox/demo first, then reversal reconciliation; no production credentials during preparation.
decisions.can_proceed_before_decision: Funding ledger, hosted-flow state machine and sandbox adapters.

decisions.question: Temperament percentages and evidence thresholds for live
options: Sign temperament percentage values and live evidence thresholds
decisions.author_recommendation: Owner signs after backtest/walk-forward per mode (DU-30); AGGRESSIVE stays unbound until an edge-evidence producer qualifies.
decisions.can_proceed_before_decision: Mode mechanics, passive monitoring and refusal logic.

decisions.question: 24h cooldown; 0.5 probation; >2 cooldowns/7d escalation; retain stated scopes under OD-38/39
options: Sign runtime activation of the already-accepted OD-39 values
decisions.author_recommendation: Values are decided (24 h cooldown, ×0.5 probation, >2 cooldowns/7 d escalation); only the runtime signing act remains.
decisions.can_proceed_before_decision: All lockout code (defaults already equal OD-39 values).

decisions.question: Approve exact operational policy domain, estimator/update rules, bounds and qualification requirements before consequential use.
options: Approve the operational policy domain, estimator/update rules, bounds and qualification before consequential use
decisions.author_recommendation: Owner approval before consequential use, by design; not a build blocker.
decisions.can_proceed_before_decision: Full self-optimization machinery in shadow/qualification without financial effect.

decisions.question: Select initial eligible spot exchange/account/product scope from current permitted access; validate authentic qualification environment.
options: Select the initial eligible spot exchange/account/product from currently permitted access
decisions.author_recommendation: Owner selects from accounts already held/permitted; no procurement inferred.
decisions.can_proceed_before_decision: Exchange-neutral capability matrix, filters, precision and adapters against public/sandbox endpoints.
